biggest_catch: Only available in deregulated energy markets outside CT/IL/NY — and the friend locks into a minimum 12-month fixed-rate plan.
catches: Connecticut, Illinois, and New York customers are ineligible
Friend must enroll in a minimum 12-month fixed-rate agreement
Gift card, not cash; no cash access
critical: Current customer in an eligible state and current on all payments
Friend enrolls in a minimum 12-month fixed-rate plan using the referral code
eligibility: Current Constellation residential electricity or natural gas customer (not in CT, IL, or NY) and current on payments
Friend uses the referral code at sign-up and enrolls in a minimum 12-month fixed-rate plan
notes: Gift cards delivered via email by Virtual Reward Center; valid email required.
payout_quote: $50 virtual Mastercard/Visa gift card to both sides for each qualified referral, up to $575 per calendar year
steps: Current Constellation customer shares their referral code
Friend signs up for Constellation service using the code
Friend completes enrollment on a minimum 12-month fixed-rate plan
Both sides receive the $50 virtual gift card by email
timing: Allow 2-4 weeks after the friend's enrollment completes for email delivery of the gift cards.
